sentences.en: Life resembles a novel more often than novels resemble life.
sentences.zh: 生活往往更像小说而不是小说像生活。

sentences.en: Do you love me just because I resemble Connie Nielsen?
sentences.zh: 你只是因为我长得像妮可·基德曼就爱我吗？

sentences.en: Yoshio resembles his mother in personality and his father in appearance.
sentences.zh: 吉 Yoshio 在性格上像他妈妈，在相貌上像他爸爸。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：re（一再）+sembl（类似）+e →类似
